content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Understanding the infrastructure behind selling Notion templates for crypto is crucial for creators facing limitations from traditional payment platforms. By leveraging COREMERCH's Sovereign Commerce Stacks, you can create a fully operational online store without the fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad, which charges up to 10% on sales. This means you retain more of your earnings while providing a seamless experience for your customers. The freedom to operate independently in the digital marketplace empowers creators to focus on their craft and grow their businesses without unnecessary barriers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the infrastructure consists of several key components: hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing with NOWPayments. This architecture allows you to automate product delivery and accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of just 0.5%. The combination of these tools ensures your digital products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation, enabling a smooth transaction experience for your customers while you maintain full ownership and control over your data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are restricted or unavailable. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this solution caters to your needs. By using COREMERCH, you are choosing a path that eliminates reliance on third-party platforms, allowing you to retain complete sovereignty over your business operations. This approach not only enhances your earning potential but also provides a more secure and efficient way to manage your digital sales.
Retain more earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of your digital storefront hinges on several integrated components. First, you need a reliable hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which allows you to serve your website at no cost. Next, you implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle backend operations, such as order processing. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, which facilitates immediate payment verification and ensures that your customers can pay using their preferred crypto without hefty fees. Each of these components plays a vital role in creating a seamless selling experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, which are designed for rapid deployment. Next, follow the setup documentation to link your hosting and backend. Ensure to integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Load your digital products, configure your delivery system, and test the entire process to confirm everything works smoothly. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have all the resources necessary to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Complete control over your digital commerce infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
